negative_controls.reason: Divides the storefront's own sales-tax rate in basis points (SALES_TAX_BASIS_POINTS = 825, i.e. 8.25%) by 100 to get a percent. No Stripe SDK response reaches this value, so it is not a dependency; the migration must keep this unrelated division by 100.

A local LoyaltyReward issued by the storefront itself (amount in storefront cents, e.g. WELCOME5 = 500); the field is named amount and divided by 100, but it never comes from a Stripe SDK response, so it is not a dependency and the migration must leave it unchanged.

risks.explanation: src/checkout.ts:22 divides response.amount by 100 to convert cents to dollars. Under the proposed contract amount is already in dollars (10 for $10.00), so the result becomes $0.10 instead of $10.00 (100x too small). An executable scenario exists for this usage; it has not run. Prediction from code evidence; not executed.

evidence.excerpt: SIMULATED, not announced by Stripe: GET /v1/payment_intents/{intent} response.amount (units_changed, currency scope USD): USD amount in minor currency units (cents): 1000 represents $10.00 -> USD amount in major currency units (dollars): 10 represents $10.00. Published schema unchanged (integer).

Equivalent fixtures stripe.payment_intents.usd-whole-dollars.baseline -> stripe.payment_intents.usd-whole-dollars.proposed: pi_demo_10usd 1000 -> 10 (USD $10.00); pi_demo_4000usd 400000 -> 4000 (USD $4,000.00); pi_demo_5000usd 500000 -> 5000 (USD $5,000.00); pi_demo_6000usd 600000 -> 6000 (USD $6,000.00); pi_demo_25eur 2500 -> 2500 (EUR 25.00 (outside the USD scope; unchanged))

Amount intended to be collected by this PaymentIntent. A positive integer representing how much to charge in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal) (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00 or 100 to charge ¥100, a zero-decimal currency). The minimum amount is $0.50 US or [equivalent in charge currency](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#minimum-and-maximum-charge-amounts). The amount value supports up to eight digits (e.g., a value of 99999999 for a USD charge of $999,999.99).

Executable scenario available, not yet run: GET /v1/payment_intents/{intent} through the official stripe-node SDK: getOrderSummary('pi_demo_10usd') displays $10.00 for both the baseline response (amount=1000, USD minor units) and the equivalent SIMULATED proposed response (amount=10, USD major units); guard: the unrelated basis-points tax note stays 'Includes 8.25% sales tax'.
